events.title: Economics may decide outcome of Iran-US standoff
events.summary: The next phase of the Iran–US standoff may be decided not on the battlefield, but by how much economic pressure each side can withstand.

events.title: United States Condemns the Pro-Hamas Global Sumud Flotilla
events.summary: The United States condemns the Global Sumud Flotilla, a pro-Hamas initiative and a baseless, counterproductive effort to undermine President Trump’s Peace Plan. This Pro-Hamas Flotilla is organized by an OFAC-sanctioned entity, the Popular Conference for Palestinians Abroad, which was designated as a specially designated global terrorist in January for operating at Hamas’ behest. The founder of the Global Sumud Flotilla has publicly expressed support for the Iranian regime and its terror proxies

events.title: Pezeshkian, Ghalibaf seek Araghchi’s ouster over 'subservience' to Guards
events.summary: Iran's president and parliament speaker are seeking Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi’s removal, accusing him of following the Revolutionary Guard chief’s instructions in nuclear talks without informing the president, two sources familiar with the matter told Iran International.

events.title: US forms new coalition to secure Hormuz, asks partners to join
events.summary: The United States has asked partner countries to join its newly formed Maritime Freedom Coalition to help secure passage through the Strait of Hormuz and Persian Gulf waterways, according to a State Department cable.

events.title: Iranians denounce tiered internet plan as discriminatory and corrupt
events.summary: Iranians condemned selective access to restricted internet services as discriminatory and corrupt in messages to Iran International, urging others to reject the scheme in recent days.

events.title: How the Taliban tilted toward Iran during wartime tensions
events.summary: Taliban leaders and affiliated figures voiced support for Iran after Israeli strikes in June 2025 and later US threats, signaling a limited and conditional alignment despite longstanding disputes with Tehran.

events.title: Iran ranks near bottom as press curbs deepen worldwide
events.summary: Iran ranked among the world’s worst countries for press freedom in 2026 as global conditions hit a 25-year low, with legal pressure on journalists intensifying across multiple regions, Reporters Without Borders said.

events.title: Soaring prices push medicine beyond Iranians' reach
events.summary: Medicine prices in Iran have surged sharply in recent weeks, with some drugs rising by as much as 380%, according to reports received by Iran International, as the country grapples with soaring inflation, a collapsing currency and worsening wartime disruption.

threads.label: US maritime coalition and flotilla condemnation
threads.summary: The State Department asked partner countries to join a newly formed Maritime Freedom Coalition to secure the Strait of Hormuz, according to a department cable reported by Iran International. Separately, the State Department condemned the Global Sumud Flotilla, noting its organiser, the Popular Conference for Palestinians Abroad, was designated a specially designated global terrorist in January.

threads.label: Tehran internal rifts over nuclear diplomacy
threads.summary: Iran International reported that President Pezeshkian and parliament speaker Ghalibaf are seeking Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi's removal, accusing him of following Revolutionary Guard instructions in nuclear talks without informing the president. A separate Iran International analysis framed the Iran–US standoff as likely to be decided by economic endurance.

threads.label: Domestic pressures: prices, internet, press
threads.summary: Iran International reported medicine prices in Iran have surged by as much as 380% amid inflation and currency collapse, and that Iranians condemned a tiered internet access scheme as discriminatory. Reporters Without Borders ranked Iran near the bottom for press freedom in 2026 as global conditions hit a 25-year low.
